BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to forfeiture of bail bonds; and adding a newsection to chapter 10.19 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 10.19 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Whenever a person's bail exceeds four hundred dollars and thebail is entered into forfeiture status, the clerk of the court shall,within thirty days of the forfeiture, mail notice of the forfeiture tothe surety. The clerk of the court shall also mail a copy of theforfeiture notice to the bail bond agent whose name appears on thebond. The clerk of the court shall execute a certificate of mailing ofeach forfeiture notice and shall place the certificate in the court'sfile. (2) If the bond displays the mailing address of the person orpersons to receive notice of forfeiture, then the notice shall bemailed to the address or addresses displayed. A mailing to only one ofthe persons listed on the bond shall not constitute compliance withthis section. p. 1 SB 5961 (3) The surety shall be released of all obligations if any of thefollowing conditions apply: (a) The clerk of the court fails to mail the required notices offorfeiture within thirty days after forfeiture; (b) The clerk of the court fails to mail notice of forfeiture tothe surety at the address shown on the bond; or (c) The clerk of the court fails to mail notice of forfeiture tothe surety's agent at the address listed on the bond.
